topic: Day 10 — carousel — The impressive life and the good-feeling life aren't always the same one

slides.text: One is optimized for how it looks from outside.
The other is optimized for how it feels from inside.
They correlate less than you'd think.

caption:
Optimizing for how your life looks from outside and optimizing for how it feels from inside can quietly diverge without you noticing.

Follow for one of these a day.
